bugs.description: Choice.normalize_choice drops the ctx is not None guard, so normalizing without a context (convert, get_missing_message or get_invalid_choice_message with ctx=None) raises AttributeError.
Choice.convert catches KeyError instead of the StopIteration that next() raises, so an invalid choice escapes as a StopIteration instead of a usage error.
test_choice_argument_none only asserts that some output was printed, so it no longer checks that the "not-none" choice is converted and echoed unchanged.
